title: Jewelled Braised Canadian Beef Tagine
description: A rich, slow-cooked beef tagine recipe featuring tender chunks of Canadian beef, creme fraiche, and sweet, dried fruits. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the bottom of the ceramic tagine over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes in batches until browned all over, about 5 minutes. Remove from the tagine and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the tagine, then add the ground ginger and ground cinnamon.
Add the beef broth, honey, and apple cider vinegar to the tagine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the beef in the oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Add the browned beef back to the tagine, along with the dried cranberries and dried apricots.
Return the tagine to the oven and braise for an additional 30 minutes.
Stir in the creme fraiche and cook for an additional 5 minutes, until heated through.
Season with kosher salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
